name: youtube
description: Search YouTube videos, get detailed info about a specific video, get a video's transcript (or description if no transcript exists), or find recent videos from a specific channel.

action.description: search: find videos by keyword. video_info: details/stats for a known video. transcript: get a video's transcript. channel_videos: recent videos from a named channel.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID (the part after watch?v=). Required for video_info and transcript.

max_results.description: Max results for search/channel_videos. Defaults to 10.
